selection.ownership: JobNimbus (Lehi, Utah, United States; Sumeru Equity Partners growth investment 2024)

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of JobNimbus Open API (app.jobnimbus.com/api1 contacts/jobs), Platform API authorization docs, company HQ/ownership, and dated incident search. JobNimbus is a US contractor CRM. No qualifying current unresolved incident was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Open API Postman collection (size/from pagination, Bearer token, https://app.jobnimbus.com/api1), support article still linking that collection on 2026-09-11, Platform API authorization page (different host/path surface), Utah HQ, and dated incident search. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck probes GET /contacts?size=1 on the Open API host. /account/settings is the pinned validator path but is not a defineProviderAction, so healthcheck maps to list_contacts.

Returns raw JobNimbus JSON under data. Optional size (1-1000) and from (offset) match Open API query names. JOBNIMBUS_CONTACT_LIST fields, filter, sort_field, and sort_direction are included; filter is a caller-supplied JSON string.
contactId is percent-encoded as one path segment on GET /contacts/{contactId}.
Returns raw JobNimbus JSON under data. Optional size/from match Open API query names. Writes are omitted.
jobId is percent-encoded as one path segment on GET /jobs/{jobId}.
POST /api1/account/filetype with TypeName/IsActive as documented by Composio JOBNIMBUS_CREATE_FILE_TYPE.
POST /api1/account/location with Open API snake_case address fields.
GET /api1/account/settings is the pinned credential validator path and JOBNIMBUS_ACCOUNT_GET_SETTINGS.
POST /api1/account/workflow/{workflowid}/status adds a status to an existing workflow.
GET /api1/activities/{jnid}.
GET /api1/activities with size/from plus Composio offset alias.
PUT /api1/contacts/{jnid}. Composio camelCase input maps onto Open API snake_case body fields.
GET /api1/files/{jnid} for JOBNIMBUS_FILE_GET.
GET /api1/v2/invoices.
POST /api1/v2/materialorders with related records and product line items.
GET /api1/v2/materialorders.
GET /api1/payments. Composio page/perPage/jobId/contactId/dateFrom/dateTo plus Open API size/from.
GET /api1/v2/products/{jnid}.
GET /api1/v2/products.
POST /api1/tasks with title, date_start, and record_type_name.
GET /api1/tasks. Composio page/per_page/status/due_date/assigned_to plus Open API size/from.
PUT /api1/tasks/{jnid}.
GET /api1/utility/uoms.
GET /api1/v2/workorders.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate the JobNimbus API key with a one-contact list probe.

contacts.list.title: List contacts
contacts.list.description: List JobNimbus contacts with optional size, from, fields, filter, and sort. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_CONTACT_LIST.

from.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.

size.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-1000). Defaults to 1000.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include.

filter.description: JSON filter for advanced querying (URL-encoded by the caller if required).

sort_field.description: Field to sort results by. Defaults to date_created.

sort_direction.description: Sort order: asc or desc. Defaults to desc.

contacts.get.title: Get contact
contacts.get.description: Retrieve one JobNimbus contact by identifier. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_CONTACT_GET.

contactId.description: The JobNimbus ID (jnid) of the contact to retrieve.

jobs.list.title: List jobs
jobs.list.description: List JobNimbus jobs with optional size and from pagination.

jobs.get.title: Get job
jobs.get.description: Retrieve one JobNimbus job by identifier.

account.filetypes.create.title: Create file attachment type
account.filetypes.create.description: Create a file attachment type used to categorize documents. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_CREATE_FILE_TYPE. POST /account/filetype.

TypeName.description: Name for the new file attachment type (for example Contract or Photo Gallery).

IsActive.description: Whether the file type is active. Defaults to true.

account.locations.create.title: Create location
account.locations.create.description: Create a company location. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_ACCOUNT_CREATE_LOCATION. POST /account/location.

account.settings.get.title: Get account settings
account.settings.get.description: Retrieve account-wide settings (workflows, types, sources). Maps to JOBNIMBUS_ACCOUNT_GET_SETTINGS. GET /account/settings.

actor.description: Optional JobNimbus user email to impersonate this request.

account.workflows.status.create.title: Create workflow status
account.workflows.status.create.description: Create a status in an existing workflow. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_CREATE_WORKFLOW_STATUS. POST /account/workflow/{workflowid}/status.

workflowid.description: ID of the target workflow from JOBNIMBUS_ACCOUNT_GET_SETTINGS.

name.description: Display name of the new status.

is_lead.description: Whether this status marks a lead.

is_archived.description: Whether this status should be archived.

force_mobile_sync.description: Whether to force mobile sync on status change.

send_to_quickbooks.description: Whether to sync this status to QuickBooks.

activities.get.title: Get activity
activities.get.description: Retrieve one JobNimbus activity by jnid. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_ACTIVITY_GET. GET /activities/{jnid}.

jnid.description: The unique JobNimbus ID (jnid) of the activity.

activities.list.title: List activities
activities.list.description: List JobNimbus activities with pagination and sort. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_LIST_ACTIVITIES. GET /activities.

from.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.

size.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-1000). Defaults to 1000.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include.

filter.description: JSON filter for advanced querying (URL-encoded by the caller if required).

sort_field.description: Field to sort results by. Defaults to date_created.

sort_direction.description: Sort order: asc or desc. Defaults to desc.

offset.description: Zero-based offset alias used by Composio; sent as the Open API from query when from is omitted.

contacts.update.title: Update contact
contacts.update.description: Update an existing contact by jnid. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_CONTACT_UPDATE. PUT /contacts/{jnid} with Open API snake_case fields.

jnid.description: Unique JobNimbus identifier of the contact to update.

company.description: Company name associated with the contact.

sourceName.description: Source from which the contact originated.

contactType.description: Type/category of the contact (record type name).

files.get.title: Get file attachment
files.get.description: Retrieve a file attachment by jnid. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_FILE_GET. GET /files/{jnid}.

jnid.description: The unique JobNimbus ID (jnid) of the file attachment.

invoices.list.title: List invoices
invoices.list.description: List JobNimbus invoices (v2). Maps to JOBNIMBUS_LIST_INVOICES. GET /v2/invoices.

from.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.

size.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-1000). Defaults to 1000.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include.

filter.description: JSON filter for advanced querying (URL-encoded by the caller if required).

sort_field.description: Field to sort results by. Defaults to date_created.

sort_direction.description: Sort order: asc or desc. Defaults to desc.

materialorders.create.title: Create material order
materialorders.create.description: Create a material order linked to a contact or job. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_CREATE_MATERIAL_ORDER. POST /v2/materialorders.

items.description: Line items that each reference an existing product by jnid.

id.description: JobNimbus identifier (jnid) of the related record.

notes.description: Optional notes or comments about the order.

status.description: Numeric status code of the material order (0-7). Use 0 for Draft.

vendorId.description: Identifier of the vendor for this order.

assignedToId.description: User ID to whom this order is assigned.

expectedDate.description: Expected delivery date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

materialorders.list.title: List material orders
materialorders.list.description: List JobNimbus material orders (v2). Maps to JOBNIMBUS_LIST_MATERIAL_ORDERS. GET /v2/materialorders.

payments.list.title: List payments
payments.list.description: List JobNimbus payments with optional filters. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_LIST_PAYMENTS. GET /payments.

page.description: Page number for pagination (>=1). Defaults to 1.

perPage.description: Number of payments per page (>=1). Defaults to 100.

jobId.description: Filter payments by associated job ID.

contactId.description: Filter payments by associated contact ID.

products.get.description: Retrieve one JobNimbus product by jnid. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_PRODUCT_GET. GET /v2/products/{jnid}.

jnid.description: The JobNimbus product ID (jnid) to retrieve.

products.list.description: List JobNimbus products. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_LIST_PRODUCTS. GET /v2/products.

tasks.create.title: Create task
tasks.create.description: Create a JobNimbus task. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_CREATE_TASK. POST /tasks.

date_start.description: Start date as a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch).

record_type_name.description: Name of the task type as defined in account settings.

date_end.description: End date as a Unix timestamp. Use 0 or omit for open-ended tasks.

record_type.description: Numeric identifier of the task type.

related.description: Related contacts or jobs to attach this task to.

id.description: jnid of the related contact or job.

tasks.list.title: List tasks
tasks.list.description: List JobNimbus tasks. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_TASK_LIST. GET /tasks.

due_date.description: Filter by due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tasks.update.title: Update task
tasks.update.description: Update an existing JobNimbus task by jnid. Maps to JOBNIMBUS_UPDATE_TASK. PUT /tasks/{jnid}.

jnid.description: JobNimbus ID (jnid) of the task to update.

description.description: New description or notes for the task.

date_start.description: New start timestamp in Unix epoch seconds.

date_end.description: New end timestamp in Unix epoch seconds.

record_type.description: Task type ID. Provide with record_type_name if updating type.

record_type_name.description: Task type name. Provide with record_type if updating type.
